light_wraith.desc: Light wraith (1.2x): a gold-white drifting shroud with a halo; no gore.

storm_sentinel.desc: Storm sentinel (1.8x): lightning golem of white stone + gold bands, a caged blue storm in the chest.

storm_centaur.desc: Storm-centaur (1.6x, sky plains): bay horse body, a storm-blue belted tunic, gold lance.

gilded_inquisitor.desc: Gilded Inquisitor (elite, 1x): hooded gold tabard over a cream tunic, belted, gold mask with red eyes, mace of light. No plate.
